requirement: A bottom bar never covers the focused field
expected: Tabbing through Inventario with the bulk bar open, the catalog with the comparison tray, a page with the alert prompt or Deshacer, and a listing on a phone keeps the focused element above the bar; the footer ends above the contact bar.
steps: Open each bar, tab through the page.

requirement: Touch targets are at least 24 px
expected: axe target-size passes on every page, including the inventory table's row links; phones have a visible Seleccionar todos.
steps: Run the page audit.

requirement: Changes are announced to screen readers
expected: Guardado on favorites, the photo summary while uploading and the catalog's result count are read as they change, without moving focus.
steps: Save a favorite, add photos in the sell form, apply a filter.

requirement: Every page passes WCAG 2.2 AA checks
expected: axe-core (WCAG 2.0 to 2.2, A and AA) reports no violations on the pages each role reaches and in the states a tap opens, at 390 and 1366 px.
steps: Run both audit scripts.

requirement: Laria installs as an app
expected: On Android Chrome Laria can be installed; it opens without the browser's bar with the Laria icon and offers Vender un instrumento and Mis favoritos on a long press.
steps: Install from Chrome's menu, open it, long-press the icon.

requirement: Laria never asks to be installed
expected: No banner or dialog of Laria's own offers the install.
steps: Browse as a visitor.

requirement: Photos shared from the gallery open the listing form
expected: Sharing up to 10 photos to installed Laria opens the Particular form (the store's for a store owner) on the photo step with them, in order; signed out it asks to sign in first and the photos wait.
preconditions: Installed app; signed in and signed out.
steps: Share two photos from the gallery to Laria.

requirement: A shared photo is used once and never resurfaces
expected: The form takes the photos once and the device copy is deleted; a share older than a day is dropped; /compartir is never indexed.
preconditions: A share left unused for a day.
steps: Share, wait, open the form.

requirement: The service worker only handles shares and notices
expected: It is registered at /compartir/ in production builds; pages, images and data come from the network with or without it.
steps: Check the registration scope and the network panel after a deploy.

requirement: Notices are turned on per device, only from the switch
expected: Activar avisos in Notificaciones asks the browser's permission; nothing asks on a first visit; once on, the phone shows a sample notice.
steps: Open Notificaciones, press Activar avisos.

requirement: A push reads and opens like its notification
expected: One notice shows the same label and listing name as its row in Notificaciones and opens the same page; several pending become one message; the phone shows one Laria notice at a time.
preconditions: A device turned on; notices created.
steps: Run the worker; tap the notice.

requirement: No push at night
expected: From 22:00 to 08:00 Lima nothing is sent; those notices go out together in the morning.
preconditions: Worker run inside the quiet hours.
steps: Run the worker at 23:00 and at 08:05 Lima.

requirement: Read or old notices are not pushed
expected: A notice read in Laria, older than three days, or for someone with no device left is skipped, never sent.
steps: Run the worker.

requirement: Pushes go only to browser push services, for the device's owner
expected: A person reaches only their own devices; endpoints outside Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft push services and malformed keys are refused; only the service role claims and finishes deliveries.
preconditions: Two accounts; signed out; service role.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: Shared phones and sign-out
expected: A device belongs to whoever turned notices on last; a person keeps ten devices at most; signing out turns that device off before the session ends.
steps: Turn notices on with A, then with B; sign out.

requirement: Failed sends retry and gone devices are forgotten
expected: A failed send retries after 5 min, 30 min, 2 h and 8 h, five attempts in all; a device the push service no longer knows, or one that failed five times in a row, is forgotten; a stopped worker's claim returns after 15 minutes.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: The push worker is protected and safe without keys
expected: The worker route needs CRON_SECRET; without VAPID keys it only logs what it would send.
preconditions: No VAPID keys; wrong and right secret.
steps: Call the route.

requirement: Messages are encrypted and signed to the standards
expected: Payloads are encrypted as RFC 8291 describes and signed with VAPID for the push service's origin.
steps: Run the unit tests.

requirement: One rule for a price drop
expected: A listing under "Bajaron de precio" (catalog sort and home row) always shows the same "Antes S/" on its card, its page and its store's page; a raise followed by a drop does not put it there.
preconditions: An approved listing lowered 5% or more after 7 days; another raised then lowered.
steps: Open the catalog sorted by Bajaron de precio, the home, the store page and each listing.

requirement: Every notice type any batch added is allowed
expected: After all migrations, the notifications and e-mail checks accept every type: the marketplace's own, questions, alert matches, check-ins, reminders, the weekly follow digest and the stock summary.
steps: Run the SQL suite.

requirement: Solicitar compra with a quantity opens WhatsApp at once
expected: With 3 units chosen, the press opens WhatsApp with "3 unidades" in the message, the contact is recorded in the background, and the safety sheet comes first when it applies.
preconditions: Payments pilot on; a store listing with stock above 1.
steps: Choose 3 and press Solicitar compra.

requirement: Ready replies use the store's hours once
expected: The ready WhatsApp replies use the pickup hours when the store wrote them, otherwise its opening hours.
preconditions: A store with opening hours and no pickup hours; then with both.
steps: Open Solicitudes and read a ready reply.

requirement: A SKU shows what its publication will start with
expected: An unpublished SKU's page shows "Datos para publicar" above "Publicar este SKU"; the category is edited only in "Categoría del SKU".
steps: Open the SKU page, change the category, open the panel.

requirement: Small meetings between batches
expected: The owner's store preview has no Seguir; the account home says "Cupo de publicaciones" and points to Mi tienda at the limit; Publicar seleccionados sends only the rows the owner ticked.
preconditions: Store owner at the allowance limit with several unpublished SKUs.
steps: Open the preview, the account home and the bulk bar.

requirement: One Vistos recientemente
expected: Every listing page opened, from a card, a link or the address bar, appears once, newest first, on the home, the catalog, the not-found page and Favoritos, each with its title and today's price; a sold one says Vendido, a removed one drops out; Borrar empties it.
steps: Open three listings in different ways, mark one sold, remove one, open each row.

requirement: One last visit
expected: After 30 minutes away, the home's "Nuevo desde tu última visita", Favoritos and Alertas count from the same moment, before and after the page marks the new visit.
preconditions: Signed-in buyer with favorites and an alert; new listings since the last visit.
steps: Come back after 30 minutes and open the home, Favoritos and Alertas.

requirement: What you follow shows on the home
expected: Signed in and following a store or a brand, the home shows "Nuevo de lo que sigues" above Para ti with up to eight listings of the last two weeks, each saying which follow brought it; visitors and people who follow nothing see no section.
preconditions: A buyer following the demo store; a visitor.
steps: Open the home as each.

requirement: Every price field reads S/ 1,250
expected: The sell form, the edit form, the inline price in Mis publicaciones, Bajar precio in Pendientes, a missing import price and a SKU's price show "S/" in front, group thousands while typing and save the whole number.
steps: Type 1250 in each and save.

requirement: Brand and model are never autocorrected
expected: On a phone, the brand and model fields of the sell form, the edit form and an import row neither autocorrect nor spell-check.
steps: Type "Ibanez RG" in each.

requirement: The store forms' WhatsApp fields and the store sign-up password
expected: The store's "WhatsApp para compradores" and the store sign-up's WhatsApp show +51 and the number buyers will see with Probar en WhatsApp; the store sign-up's password has the eye.
steps: Type 987 654 321 in each; show the password.

requirement: The profile notice waits for publications
expected: A new account with only a name and an e-mail sees no "Completa tu perfil Particular" on Mi cuenta; someone with publications and no WhatsApp does; Publicar asks for WhatsApp and city the first time.
preconditions: A new buyer account; a Particular with a listing and the WhatsApp removed.
steps: Open Mi cuenta and Publicar as each.

requirement: Store details stay private and the store pages still work
expected: Anonymous visitors cannot read stores' RUC, e-mail or street address through the table; the purchase requests page and the account pages read the owner's own row.
preconditions: Database with every migration; a signed-in store owner.
steps: Query stores as anon; open Solicitudes.

requirement: Every migration applies over one connection
expected: All migrations replay in one database session, as the Supabase CLI applies them, with no leftover session helpers.
steps: Run the single-session replay.

requirement: Every shared link has a picture
expected: A link to the catalog, the stores directory, a store without a logo, the legal pages or the Libro de Reclamaciones previews with the Laria card; X shows the large card.
steps: Read og:image and twitter:card on each page, or paste the links in WhatsApp.
